verdict.rationale: Stripe's docs show a server-side Financial Connections API. The server returns a client_secret to launch the auth flow, exposes balances and transaction history, offers a relink API, and emits refresh webhooks. Stripe also documents an official MCP server that lets agents call the Stripe API, and lists an agent-oriented 'Link CLI' use case for balance and transaction monitoring. However, nothing shows the MCP server exposing Financial Connections operations specifically, and scoped credentials for agents are not documented. missing for 10: scoped/restricted credential documentation for agent access, explicit MCP tool coverage of Financial Connections sessions/accounts, explicit session-creation endpoint docs, independent hands-on corroboration of agent operation
